story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by angels and devils. Angels always tell the truth, and devils always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Owen, and Benjamin. Owen told you that Owen is an angel if and only if Benjamin is a devil. Benjamin asserted: "Benjamin is an angel or Owen is an angel". So who is an angel and who is a devil? (Format your answer like: "Owen is a angel/devil, and Benjamin is a angel/devil")

options: Owen is an angel, Benjamin is an angel
Owen is a devil, Benjamin is a devil
Owen is a devil, Benjamin is an angel
Owen is an angel, Benjamin is a devil
